text: # dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2: pinned DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + the 062126 trace corpus into one HF cache on fresh node-local
# NVMe (refs/main written = the pins, for offline loads). Unlike experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90-sa/prepare.sh, this does
# NOT assume the model already sits on this node from an earlier job -- it downloads fresh every time, so it works
# on whichever node the hold job lands on. HF token on the node host only, never in a container.
echo "[dl] $(date -u +%T) start; hub $HUB_NL; huggingface_hub $($PYDL -c "import huggingface_hub as h; print(h.__version__)")"
for repo, rev, kind in items:
p = snapshot_download(repo, revision=rev or None, repo_type=kind, cache_dir=hub, max_workers=16)
idx = [f for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")]
want = set(json.load(open(os.path.join(p, idx[0])))["weight_map"].values()) if idx else set()
missing = [f for f in want if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p, f))]
d = os.path.join(hub, ("datasets--" if kind == "dataset" else "models--") + repo.replace("/", "--"), "refs")
n = sum(1 for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors"))
print(f"[dl] ok {repo}@{rev[:10]} ({kind}): {n} shards, {len(files)} entries, {time.time()-t:.0f} s -> refs/main pinned", flush=True)
# Smoke and before/after measurements for dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2 (full AgentX at C1 and GSM8K, before and after the
# campaign). Serves the tree in the container exactly as Arbor builds the launch (arbor/frameworks/vllm.py: vllm
# serve ..., with the config server_env and ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpus>, HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES set to the same GPU
# count: arbor/frameworks/base.py), on a fresh server; runs the packs bench_agentx.sh (the AgentX replay, DURATION
# s), then GSM8K via InferenceX own run_lm_eval helper (benchmark_lib.sh, infx/evals/gsm8k.yaml -- the same
# mechanism used by the Kimi K3.1 Pro vLLM campaign, kimik31pro-c1/run_gsm8k.sh); stops that server (its own process
# group only). Adapted from experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90-sa/calib.sh (never finished: no GSM8K, no idempotency guard)
# usage: bash ab.sh <tag> <duration_s> <gsm8k_questions>      e.g.  before 3600 1319 | after 3600 1319 | smoke 600 200
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 3 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" && die "a server already answers on port $PORT"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format=tree_%H_%s; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | head -20" > "$OUT_H/tree.txt"
cfg, envf, serve, gpus, port, dur, outc = sys.argv[1:8]
env["ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = gpus; env["HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ",".join(str(i) for i in range(len(gpus.split(","))))
for k, v in env.items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n")
log "$TAG: tree $(head -1 "$OUT_H/tree.txt" | cut -c1-80); server on GPUs $GPUS port $PORT; AgentX ${DUR}s; GSM8K $NQ"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "vllm serve .*--port $PORT " >/dev/null || { log "$TAG: FATAL server died"; tail -30 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 5 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" || { log "$TAG: FATAL not healthy after 40 min"; tail -20 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "pid=\$(pgrep -f \"vllm serve .*--port $PORT \" | head -1); [ -n \"\$pid\" ] && kill -TERM -- -\$(ps -o pgid= -p \$pid | tr -d ' ') 2>/dev/null; sleep 30; \
for p in \$(pgrep -f VLLM::); do grep -qa \"ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPUS\" /proc/\$p/environ 2>/dev/null && kill -9 \$p; done; true"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c ". $OUT_C/server.env; export PORT=$PORT MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_C MODEL_NAME=$MODEL_ID CONCURRENCY=1 NUM_PROMPTS=320 \
log "$TAG: AgentX rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T1 )) s"
except Exception as e: sys.exit(f"[ab] no bench_output.json: {e}")
"$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd /workspace/InferenceX && source benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh && timeout 5400 run_lm_eval --port $PORT --task infx/evals/gsm8k.yaml --results-dir $OUT_C/gsm8k" \
log "$TAG: GSM8K ($NQ requested, task config controls actual count) rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T2 )) s"
print("[ab] no gsm8k results_*.json found"); sys.exit(0)
print("[ab] gsm8k " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in r.items() if "exact_match" in k))

# Provision the node for dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2 (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, Arbor standalone, Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test --
# user-specified 2026-11-14, not inherited from the two stalled prior attempts, which had used Arbor main). Idempotent;
# run on the GPU node through ctrl/. Adapted from experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90-sa/prepare.sh, with two changes: step 3
# installs the patched bench_agentx.sh from experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/stage/ (v0.9.2-baseline-test's stock agentx
# pack bench script does not compute e2e_norm_intvty_p90/p50 at all -- confirmed via musespark-c1-p90-sa's own GUIDE.md
# "Known weaknesses" note -- so the objective metric would be silently missing without this); step 5 verifies dl.sh's
# fresh download instead of assuming the model already sat on this specific node's NVMe (a node-affinity assumption
# that does not hold for a new hold job), same check style as experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/prepare.sh. Steps:
#   1. node checks: docker, GPUs idle, other users' containers listed (never touched)
#   2. the CI image, checked by digest
#   3. Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test from the archive (plain tree + a local git commit), our pack + patched bench + config
#   5. the HF cache on NVMe: model + corpus at their pins (dl.sh), every shard resolving
#   6. the container: the NVMe hub at /hf-hub, InferenceX, Arbor, sessions
#   7. stack versions; the vLLM tree as a git repository (Arbor's workspace_root)
#   8. the aiperf environment for the bench (InferenceX's install_agentic_deps)
#   9. ruppell for the profiler skill (not fatal)
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "no working docker daemon"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -v "^$CONTAINER " | sed 's/^/[prepare] other container (not ours, not touched): /'
[ "${vram:-0}" -le 1 ] || die "a GPU is in use before start"
case "$digests" in *"$IMAGE_DIGEST"*) log "image ok: $IMAGE_TAG = $IMAGE_DIGEST";; *) die "image digest mismatch or missing: '$digests'";; esac
git -C "$ARBOR" init -q && git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh add -A \
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -q -m "AMD-AGI/Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test $ARBOR_SHA (archive)" || die "Arbor git"
log "pack $PACK and config $CONFIG_REL installed (bench_agentx.sh overridden with the e2e_norm_intvty-patched version)"
python3 -m venv "$VENV" && "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && "$PY" -m pip install -q pyyaml claude-agent-sdk || die "venv"
render=$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3); video=$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "find -L /hf-hub/$CORPUS_DIR/snapshots -type f | head -1 | grep -q ." || die "trace corpus not visible"
log "48 shards and the 062126 corpus visible in the container"
python3 -c "import vllm, torch; print(\"vllm:\", vllm.__version__, vllm.__file__); print(\"torch:\", torch.__version__, torch.version.hip)"
VLLM_DIR=$(docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c 'import os, vllm; print(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__))' 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo repo present at \$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); exit 0; }
git init -q . && git config user.email arbor@local && git config user.name Arbor && git config core.fileMode false
git add -A 2>/dev/null && git commit -q -m \"baseline: vllm as shipped in $IMAGE_TAG\"
echo initialised \$(git ls-files | wc -l) files at \$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
if [ -x "${AIPERF_CLI:-}" ] && [ -f "$AIPERF_RUNTIME_DIR/.ready" ]; then echo "aiperf present"; exit 0; fi
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'test -f /root/inferencex-agentic/.ready' || die "aiperf environment not ready"

[ -z "$(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain)" ] && log "InferenceX still clean at $(git -C "$INFX" rev-parse --short HEAD)" || log "WARNING InferenceX tree changed: $(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
